name: WARNING: Olive Garden Fried Mozzarella with Marinara
whyItWorks: Thick planks of mozzarella cheese coated in herb breadcrumbs and deep-fried, served with garlic marinara. Molten dense cheese combined with frying oil forms a heavy bolus that stalls gastric emptying and strains strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip fried cheese appetizers. Start your meal with plain bread or hot water with lemon.
